title: masters-experiment-on-missing-data
summary: A master's research codebase that trains CTGAN synthesizers on complete and artificially incomplete tabular datasets to study the effect of missing data on synthetic data generation, then evaluates results with quality metrics and downstream classifiers. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) with SingleTableMetadata and sdv.evaluation.single_table.QualityReport as the core generation and evaluation pipeline.
